summary: End-to-end validation of the Officer Review Inbox feature (SIH26129 human-in-the-loop). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_review_flow.py covering manual pause at AWAITING_REVIEW, pending inbox listing, sanction happy path (SANCTIONED -> READY -> COMPLETED 4/4, disbursement_count=1, canonical.benefit.sanctionedBy='Meera Kulkarni'), reject flow (REJECTED, treasury stays PENDING, disbursement_count=0), auth checks (operator 403, citizen 403 for both /api/reviews GET and /api/reviews/{key}/decision POST), remarks<5 chars -> 422, stale version -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT, already-decided -> 409 NOT_REVIEWABLE, auto-mode journey completes 4/4 with review.mode='auto'/officer_name='Demonstration auto-sanction' and is absent from the official's decided tab, citizen projection hides officer_id but exposes officer_name. Frontend Playwright: (1) demo-official-select login lands on /operations/reviews with current-user='Meera Kulkarni · Deputy Commissioner, Skill Development' and sidebar containing exactly nav-reviews/nav-transactions/nav-policy/nav-audit (no nav-overview/connectors/health). (2) Operator demo journey (scenario-success + review-mode-manual) creates a TXN that within ~seconds shows transaction-status 'Under department review', review-pending visible, review-panel absent, journey-stage-count '2 of 4'. (3) Operations overview metric-2 caption reads 'N awaiting officer decision' while manual cases pend. (4) Official inbox shows review-tabs / review-count-pending / rows for our txn; opening a row navigates to /operations/transactions/TXN. (5) Review panel shows title 'Officer decision required'; review-sanction and review-reject are disabled with 0 chars and with 3 chars, enabled at >=5 chars; sanction produces review-outcome with title 'Sanctioned by the department' and officer-line containing 'Meera Kulkarni · Deputy Commissioner, Skill Development'; status becomes 'Completed' and '4 of 4 stages complete' within ~15s. (6) Decided tab lists our sanctioned case with review-decision text 'Sanctioned'. (7) back-to-applications link reads 'Review inbox' with href='/operations/reviews'. (8) Responsive at 390x844 — /operations/reviews, case page and login page all report scrollWidth-clientWidth=0 (no horizontal overflow) and login shows all three role preset cards. No app code was modified.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/router.py line 87 uses raw '==' for the optimistic-locking version check but load()->project() does not carry back the persisted revision inside the mutation transaction — the current code path is safe (load re-reads before compare) but a future refactor that reuses a stale in-memory copy would silently allow double decisions; consider promoting the check to a filtered update_one({'id':..,'version':body.version}) with modified_count assertion inside save().

backend/modules/router.py review flow calls publish_pending(app['id']) after both SANCTIONED and REJECTED branches; on REJECTED there is no downstream stage for the worker to process — the enqueue is harmless but wasteful and creates noise on the events stream. Minor.

modules/policy.py 'inspect' permission grants official read on /api/reviews but visibility() filters to departments containing user.department; if a future stage is added for a different department the inbox would silently exclude those cases. Add a smoke assertion in tests when new departments are onboarded.

Frontend ReviewPanel gates sanction/reject on remarks.length>=5 client-side; server also enforces via Pydantic (422). Good defense in depth. Consider trimming whitespace client-side so '     ' (5 spaces) does not enable the button before the server rejects — currently the server .strip()s but the client uses raw length.

seed_data_creation: Created ~7 manual-review demo journeys and 1 auto-mode journey via POST /api/demo/journeys during pytest+Playwright. Some remain UNDER_REVIEW (5 pending rows observed at run end) — main agent may want to sanction/reject or clear demo_scenarios collection before recording. TXN-1E4EBE2E1517 pre-created case was left untouched (not consumed by tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reviews feature is fully working. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_review_flow.py — each test creates its own manual journey and (where applicable) cleans up by rejecting the case, so it is idempotent across reruns. If the pending backlog grows too large, main agent can bulk-reject via official session. Auto-mode journey time-to-completion is ~15s in this env — bump _wait_status timeout if the worker is under load. Overview metric-2 caption is dynamic ('N awaiting officer decision') driven by pending count.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — this iteration is a green build validation of the new Officer Review Inbox rather than a bug hunt. All acceptance criteria from the review request (LOGIN, CREATE PENDING CASE, REVIEW INBOX, SANCTION, PAYMENT PROOF, DECIDED TAB, REJECT FLOW, AUTHORIZATION, AUTO MODE REGRESSION, OVERVIEW METRIC, RESPONSIVE) were exercised and passed. Only forward-looking hardening suggestions are captured under critical_code_review_comments.
